patch.summary:
Choose Mailchimp only if your buying job matches “Email marketing with CRM features; freemium entry (secondary category: marketing).” rather than Pipeline CRM's shape. Choose Pipeline CRM only if your buying job matches “Sales pipeline CRM (Pipeline Pro/PipelineDeals); Start from $25/user/mo annual through Gro” rather than Mailchimp's shape. Workflow advantage: Mailchimp leans lead-management, contact-management; Pipeline CRM leans pipeline-management, deal-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: Mailchimp is Email marketing with CRM features; freemium entry (secondary category: marketing).; Pipeline CRM is Sales pipeline CRM (Pipeline Pro/PipelineDeals); Start from $25/user/mo annual through Grow $49..

- Researched limits: Mailchimp — Marketing-led CRM — not a full sales pipeline platform; Pipeline CRM — Smaller ecosystem than HubSpot/Salesforce.
